title: Aligning Robot’s Behaviours and Users’ Perceptions Through Participatory Prototyping
reasoning: The paper focuses on Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) and user perception alignment using a participatory design methodology. While 'ethical concern' is identified as one of the qualitative categories used to classify user feedback during the study, the research does not formally evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems, nor is it the central focus of the work.
